run_ml_train_co2r: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with random forest and cross validation
run_ml_train_her: run ML model training on HER experimental data with linear regression and cross validation
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run ML training with Matminer elemental features added to the feature set
run_ml_train_from_processed_df: run ML training by loading a preprocessed dataframe instead of raw CSV files
run_ml_train_filter_matched: run ML training filtered to only XRD matched samples with a specific energy aggregation method
